topics.brief: Outline: authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and why it is now mandatory; list hygiene and engagement signals; content triggers and spammy patterns; warming a domain or IP; Gmail and Yahoo bulk-sender rules; monitoring with seed tests and postmaster tools. Verify: current Gmail/Yahoo sender requirements and DMARC enforcement norms. Sources: email provider sender guidelines, deliverability best-practice docs. Concrete how-to, no vendor hype.

topics.brief: Outline: how to measure marketing when third-party cookies and cross-site tracking fade; first-party data and server-side tracking; consent and privacy constraints; modeled and marketing-mix approaches vs last-click; UTM discipline; a pragmatic attribution setup for a small team. topics.angle: guide: what passkeys are and whether to switch

Verify: current passkey/FIDO support across major platforms and browsers. Sources: FIDO Alliance, platform passkey docs. A clear, consumer-friendly explainer with honest caveats.

topics.titleTr: Matter ile Akilli Ev Artik Sorunsuz mu?

topics.brief: Outline: what Matter and Thread promised; what actually works across Apple, Google and Amazon now; newer connectivity options (Wi-Fi HaLow, Z-Wave Long Range, Aliro for access control); setup gotchas and multi-admin pain; whether to buy Matter-only gear today. Use ABI's smart-home shipment growth (1.1B in 2026 to 1.4B by 2030) as context. Verify: Matter/Aliro status and ABI figures. Sources: ABI Research 2026, Connectivity Standards Alliance. Be honest about the rough edges.

Verify: current cross-document view-transitions browser support. Sources: MDN View Transitions API, web.dev. Field-notes tone with code-level gotchas and a working example.
